predicate.name: Surface same treatment
predicate.description: The surface gives two records the same identity-relevant treatment.

predicate.name: Faithful
predicate.description: `O` never separates a pair that `D` relates: the declared relation is contained in the treatment relation.

predicate.name: Divergence witness
predicate.description: A pair that `D` relates and `O` separates.

predicate.name: Declared faithful to a surface
predicate.description: A surface is faithful to a declared relation when the declaration is contained in the surface's treatment relation.

predicate.name: Store treatment
predicate.description: The store treats two records the same when every examined surface does.

predicate.name: Restriction to the declared classes
predicate.description: A relation restricted to the pairs a declared relation relates.

predicate.name: Aligned
predicate.description: Inside the declared classes, `O` splits exactly as `S` does.

predicate.name: Sub-sibling
predicate.description: Inside the declared classes, `O` splits strictly more finely than `S`.

predicate.name: Super-sibling
predicate.description: Inside the declared classes, `O` makes some but not all of the distinctions `S` makes.

predicate.name: Sibling-incomparable
predicate.description: Inside the declared classes, `O` and `S` each make a distinction the other lacks.

predicate.name: Substitution
predicate.description: The treatment relation equals the supplied alternative everywhere.
